751-3480-6006.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1808-3000-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

3090-4247-5571--6.description:
Use Harmless Offering to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 2.

62-833-3147-3827.notablePrerequisites:
Soul of Windgrace can attack without taking damage.
Savage Ventmaw can attack without taking damage.
62-833-3147-3827.description:
Declare Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding six mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Azorius Chancery from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Azorius Chancery, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1870-3609-4153.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put an artifact into your graveyard from the battlefield.
1870-3609-4153.description:
Cast Eternity Vessel by paying {6}. It will enter with a number of charge counters on it equal to your life total.
Cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield. When it does, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a number of charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter equal to the number Eternity Vessel had on it.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat step 3 as able each turn.
1870-3609-4153.notes: The total number of turns you will get is equal to: (your life total + the number of charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter)/3, rounded down.

215-225-2404-7895.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.
215-225-2404-7895.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Little Bear to your hand.
Cast Little Bear by paying {2}{G}.
When Little Bear enters, it triggers itself, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant any number of times.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

392-2921-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}
Repeat
392-2921-5220-7855--180.notes: The chosen Goblin, Orc or Army must be castable for {R}.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5662-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reyhan.
When Reyhan dies, its persist ability and innate ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reyhan from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the innate trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on a creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-4050-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
978-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat.

546-4613-5900-7607.easyPrerequisites: There are at least five land card(s) in all graveyards
546-4613-5900-7607.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Centaur Vinecrasher. Centaur Vinecrasher enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Centaur Vinecrasher using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

891-1052-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

413-6096-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
413-6096-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the General Kreat trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7229.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ambitious Dragonborn.
When Ambitious Dragonborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

465-3175-3967.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-5086-5183-6753-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-5086-5183-6753-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1818-2919-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-2919-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2104-6122-6991.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Donnie & April by paying its mana cost.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Donnie & April from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
2104-6122-6991.notes: If you cast Donnie & April from the command zone to start, you must be able to pay for commander tax that first turn.

147-413-5117.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, Undying Malice triggers, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.

1074-4222-6723.description:
Activate King Macar by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do so.
Repeat.

222-527-4885-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4885-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1550-4251-6791.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1550-4251-6791.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1651-2073-5315-6757--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the noncreature artifact enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the noncreature artifact returned in step 1 and the Munitions token, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the noncreature artifact.
Repeat.
1651-2073-5315-6757--90.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions to get infinite damage if desired. If the noncreature artifact chosen can sacrifice itself without tapping or additional costs, you can omit the sacrifice outlet, but will forego the possibility of infinite damage.

3951-4192-5231-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Ashes of the Fallen on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
3951-4192-5231-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase.

requires.n: Creature with MV=1 and Creates Creature Token(s) on Death

2178-5231-6542--110.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with mana value 0.
2178-5231-6542--110.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Repeat.

1117-2866-4985-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-1575-5686-5903.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other artifact.
856-1575-5686-5903.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing another artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar
Repeat.

774-2653-3756.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1750-1979-3528-5261.notablePrerequisites: Efreet Flamepainter does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1750-1979-3528-5261.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Efreet Flamepainter.
Efreet Flamepainter triggers, causing you to cast Rise of the Eldrazi from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rise of the Eldrazi, destroying a permanent, causing a player to draw four cards, and causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile it.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Rise of the Eldrazi from exile into your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

2919-2999-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
2919-2999-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1992-2646.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
413-1992-2646.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, Basri's Lieutenant's second ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
When the Knight enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

654-1021-1315-3430.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain two life.
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, triggering Amulet of Vigor, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Repeat.

1808-4050-4659-5267.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Eloise's and Ulvenwald Mysteries' second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Eloise trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Ulvenwald Mysteries trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Human Soldier, adding one mana of any color.
Eloise's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve Eloise's first trigger, causing you to investigate.
 Resolve Eloise's second trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities.
